build_charades_dataframe: build a pandas DataFrame from a CSV, video directory, and classes file for the Charades dataset
create_gif_from_images: create an animated GIF from a list of PIL images and save it to a temporary path
select_clips_from_video: select evenly spaced frames from a video using presentation timestamps and a target frame count
compute_video_clips: compute video clips with a specified number of frames and frame rate for all loaded videos
get_video_clip: get a subclip tensor, audio tensor, and metadata dict by index from a CharadesVideoClips instance
